title: Scream 3
tagline: Third time round. Dessert's still at risk.
about: Sidney comes out of hiding when a killer starts working through the cast of Stab 3 on a Hollywood studio lot.
cue: Serve the quesadillas when Gale talks her way onto the Stab 3 set at Sunrise Studios.
